rationale: The agent authenticated the user by matching full name and zip to a single account before proceeding. It used the product tools to retrieve Mechanical Keyboard variants and correctly identified the cheapest available option (full size, tactile, white backlight at $226.11). When asked for cheaper alternatives, it accurately stated none were lower-priced. No account changes, exchanges, or returns were performed without confirmation—indeed, no write actions were needed since the user chose to keep the current keyboard. The information provided matched the tool data, and there were no unsupported claims or policy violations. While the agent could have listed other available options with prices, its statement that all others are higher was correct and sufficient for the user’s decision.
